End the run script here unless the real data ran

Source: R/scenarios.R
end_unless_real.Rd

end_unless_real() ends a run script after save_results() when the scenario "real" is not among the scenarios of the run. The part of the script after it is for the real results only, for example the figures.

Usage

end_unless_real(scenarios)

Arguments

scenarios

The scenarios of the run, from scenarios().

Value

Invisibly, NULL, when "real" is in scenarios.

Details

  • When "real" is in scenarios, end_unless_real() does nothing, and the script continues.

  • Otherwise, in a non-interactive R session, for example under Rscript, it prints one line, flushes the output and quits R with status 0. No line after it runs.

  • Otherwise, in an interactive R session, it stops with an error of class pbn_end_unless_real. The R session stays open.

See also

vignette("pbn"), which builds and runs a small fake project.

Other project setup: create_project(), folder(), initialize_project(), new_version(), scenarios()

Examples

CFG <- list(scenarios = data.frame(scenario = c("real", "null"), sims = 1))
pbn::end_unless_real(pbn::scenarios(CFG))
